subject.title: feat(ui): path-based session and dashboard URLs

question: Should already-published Control UI `?session=` links continue to resolve through a one-time canonical redirect, or should maintainers intentionally retire that released deep-link contract?
rationale: The branch explicitly breaks previously generated links across user bookmarks and ClickClack history, which is a product and upgrade-policy choice rather than a mechanical code-style decision.

options.title: Preserve and canonicalize legacy links
options.body: Parse existing query-form session and face parameters at the UI boundary, resolve them once, and replace the URL with the new path form.

options.title: Approve retirement of legacy links
options.body: Land the breaking change only with explicit maintainer approval and a user-facing migration/release communication plan.

recommendation.title: Preserve and canonicalize legacy links
recommendation.body: Parse existing query-form session and face parameters at the UI boundary, resolve them once, and replace the URL with the new path form.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete is assigned to this PR and authored the proposed URL-contract and routing changes.
